entries.claim: `notYetFixed` trusts any truthy `fix_commit` as proof that a survivor is already fixed, with no validation that the value is actually a real commit.
entries.failure_scenario: A stored adjudication record containing `{"ruling":"survived","severity":"medium","fix_commit":"not-a-real-sha"}` is treated as already fixed, so `unfixed` drops the finding from `findings` and reports success even though no fix exists. That is a silent loss of a live finding from issue filing.

counter_evidence.note: `unfixedFindings` calls `buildEntries` BEFORE any filtering, and `buildEntries` refuses a `survived` ruling whose `fix_commit` fails FIX_COMMIT = /^[0-9a-fA-F]{7,40}$/ (lib/adjudication-record.mjs:162 and 450-453). The literal "not-a-real-sha" fails that test, so `unfixedFindings` returns ok:false and `cmdUnfixed` emits bad-payload and RETURNS at issue-filing.mjs:254-262 - before the `notYetFixed` filter at line 278 is ever reached. The payload this finding posits cannot reach the line it cites.

entries.claim: Blank or whitespace `fix_commit` values are normalized to `null`, so malformed survivor entries are rendered as if they legitimately had no commit rather than being rejected.
entries.failure_scenario: A corrupted `survived` record such as `{"severity":"high","fix_commit":"   "}` parses successfully and `/why` prints `fix: none - confirmed and left standing`. The output looks like a valid unfixed survivor even though the stored record is malformed, which hides the corruption and gives a false explanation of the outcome.

counter_evidence.note: The write side is fail-CLOSED and already refuses the record this finding posits: fix_commit: "   " fails FIX_COMMIT = /^[0-9a-fA-F]{7,40}$/ here, so `buildEntries` rejects it and it never reaches disk. The fail-soft read is locked decision D-08 and the cited line in why-record.mjs carries a comment stating the property as intended - an absent value and a blank one are the same answer to the only question asked there. A reader deliberately kept fail-soft behind a fail-closed writer is an approach difference, not a defect.
